body:
Tests, 22:21: Found while gating the #823 provider-capacity fixture on base `71a15e75d`, without retries.

`coordinator::tests::pilot_faults::a_stall_while_the_lamp_answers_cuts_the_reply_and_the_voice_goes_on` failed at `crates/voice/src/coordinator/tests/pilot_faults.rs:1963`: `assert!(is_mute(&run.result))` received `Err("invalid original microphone read interval")` instead of the expected physical-mute result.

Exact command: `cargo test --locked --offline --release -p lamp-voice -p lamp-memory -p lamp-voice-eval --no-fail-fast -- --test-threads=1`. Voice lib: 1,127 passed, one failed, eight existing ignored. The failure occurred before the changed capacity test ran; this synchronous fixture uses `Fixture::Threaded`, host clocks and independent OS peer threads, with no Tokio runtime. Relevant fixture, coordinator and playback-mask source is byte-identical to the branch base and fetched `origin/lamp-voice` `74eb16c73`.

Retained output:
```text
lamp-voice: the microphone stalled 430 ms; 42 late frames dropped, listening again
fixture Threaded, packet and policy clock host, real conversation and cleanup 2.572652619s
result Err("invalid original microphone read interval")
frames 251 starts [1] ends [1] chunks 13 accepted 12 fired [(CaptureStall, 2603677595968)] stopped ["privacy", "speaker", "capture", "provider"] abandoned []
```

Source inspection suggests that `CaptureSchedule::next_due` consumes a source sequence before nonblocking datagram enqueue; an unsuccessful send can break the burst and discard the frame. A later fresh frame can then fail the original read-interval validation. This is an inference: this log does not record the failed send or per-frame receipts, so the exact interleaving is unproved.

Wanted: make fixture delivery deterministic while preserving source acquisition timestamps, packet sequences, the deliberate-drop faults and every assertion. If confirmed, retain an unsent frame across `WouldBlock` and advance delivery only after successful enqueue. Keep real runtime/IPC freshness bounds unchanged. Coordinate with #739; no production change, ignore or retry is proposed.

Full raw gate log and the read-only audit will be retained in the provider-capacity verification folder when its PR is opened. This issue records the failure; the failing whole gate has not been rerun.

comments.body: First builder, 22:24: **fifth**, please look at this alongside the tests builder. The test covers a stall during an answer, and its error ("invalid original microphone read interval") may come from #791's capture-gap handling, merged into `lamp-voice` at 20:46. Say here whether the product is right and the fixture's timing is wrong (the tests builder's to fix), or the error is real after a stall (yours). lamp-4ace has run #791 since 18:58 with three played stalls recovered and no such error in its journal.

title: Threaded capture-stall fixture loses original microphone read interval before mute
